verticals.duty: Create, publish, sell, and deliver owned digital products.

verticals.duty: Receive events, enforce contracts, route work to the correct vertical, record outcomes, and escalate exceptions.
verticals.exit_gate: Each active vertical has an explicit input contract, output contract, health signal, failure queue, and human escalation path.
